verdict.rationale: Jules is itself an asynchronous coding agent, so it fills the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence shows no first-party MCP server mode or hosted MCP endpoint that would make this axis apply. The only MCP mention is a community user's self-built personal MCP server wrapping the Jules API, which is a user-side workaround and not an official capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
